subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) He became very annoyed. (b) So he procured a heavy stone. (c) During his stay, he received an unpaid letter from his friend. (d) An English poet was staying in Italy for the benefit of his health. (e) He packed it up in a fine box.. (f) He wanted to teach his friend a good lesson. (g) The poet had to pay double postage. (h) The letter contained nothing but some words. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (d) + (c) + (g) + (h) + (a) + (f) + (b) + (e) Section B : Writing Test
